target.statement: 11 NUTS2 regions flagged as structural anomalies by at least 3 of 5 methods (Table 2), and per-method flagged counts (Table 1: z-scores 12, Mahalanobis 3, IF/LOF/OCSVM 15 each)
target.dataset: Eurostat NUTS2 2022 cross-section (nama_10r_2gdp, lfst_r_lfu3rt, demo_r_d3dens, edat_lfse_04), ~260 regions x 4 indicators

compute.basis: Tiny 260x4 table, four Eurostat API downloads, and scikit-learn anomaly detectors (IF/LOF/OCSVM/Mahalanobis) that run in seconds on CPU; main cost is installing packages and fetching data.

blockers: Code repo linked but not verified to contain the exact script/config; may need to reimplement the pipeline from the paper
Eurostat API dataset codes/units must be matched and 2022 values may have been revised since publication, so exact flagged counts may not reproduce bit-for-bit
title: Unsupervised Machine Learning for Detecting Structural Anomalies in European Regional Statistics
